data.text: Competitor missing from every doc until 2026-10-15: Kurrent Capacitor (kcap, by Kurrent ex-Event Store, GA 2026-06-04). Captures every agent turn and tool call as immutable events in an append-only stream on a Kurrent-hosted per-org server (EU); team memory holds decisions; work items group sessions, no claims. Free 5 seats, Team $15/seat/mo; CLI source-available (Kurrent License v1). So 'events, not state' no longer sets kadence apart; what still does is curated tasks/claims/decisions as files in the commit, offline, nothing to run. Added to strategy §4 (with a proposed wording change for the owner) and competitive-snapshot §8.
